To get the best result with Loop Dream™: 
Hold the earplugs between your fingers with the ear tip pointing toward your face.
Open your ear canal by gently pulling the back of your ear.
Insert the ear tip carefully — no need to twist (unlike other Loop Earplugs models).
Press lightly on the earplug for about 5 seconds to create a snug seal.
Check the fit: 
If they feel loose or fall out try a larger ear tip.
If they feel too tight or stick out go down a size.
Move your jaw side to side — if they stay in place and you hear your own voice louder, that’s a good seal.
